title: Apple Frameworks and Real-World App Features
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of apple frameworks and real-world app features in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 18: Apple Frameworks and Real-World App Features. Lessons in order: Introduction to Apple Application Frameworks; UIKit and SwiftUI Interoperability; Application Lifecycle; Local Persistence with SwiftData; Core Data Fundamentals; Preferences and Small-Scale Storage; Authentication and Identity; Secure Storage with Keychain; Working with Remote APIs in SwiftUI; Images and Media; Notifications and Background Work; Device Capabilities and Permissions; Accessibility in SwiftUI; Localization and Internationalization; Apple Platform Release and Distribution.
